borrowed: behaviour only — layout, density and gesture. No ontology, no backend.
shape: one page over live Aurekai endpoints; every pane names the path that produced it
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — offers the session that would fill it
empty (200, no records) — an empty projection
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
actions: offered, never submitted; Authority gates at effect time
forbidden_inference: a swipe -> intent; attention reorders what is offered and opens no obligation
a ranked item -> an authorized action
reads_note: the pattern name is derived from the host, so .life reads night-life and .work reads night-work -- which answers 403 and takes the refusal path
requires_authority: none to render; every verb is checked at effect time by the owner of the effect

lineage.note_licence: licence classification removed: the operator owns these projects and an automated pass had marked them otherwise. Provenance is kept because it is what makes the vendoring checkable, not because it is a permission.
